wiki.title: Theresa Manzella
wiki.extract: Theresa Manzella (born November 26, 1964) is an American politician. She serves as a Republican member of the Montana Senate, representing District 44 since January 2021. From 2015 to 2021, she served in the Montana House of Representatives, representing District 85, which included parts of Hamilton, Montana.
